response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience and exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and MCP protocols, but lacks clear evidence of 8+ years building production-grade AI solutions, direct experience with vector databases or RAG architectures, and leadership in customer-facing technical discovery — key requirements for this staff-level GenAI role.

Proven full-stack expertise across TypeScript, cloud (AWS), and scalable systems

concerns: No explicit mention of vector databases, RAG, or LLM optimization in work history
Lacks demonstrable experience leading technical discovery sessions with enterprise customers
Education shows BS in CS but no advanced degree, and AI-specific projects are underrepresented
